Could someone explain more in dept about the AIDS virus and why its so hard to find a cure/make a vaccine?

Super simplified: HIV mutates quickly. Every virus, every bacteria, every cell in your body has attachment points for immune cells that can either recognize them as good or bad. Think of it as a nametag at a party.
Sometimes when an immune cell doesn't recognize something, it has refer to it's manual to see if it's good or bad, this takes time and in the meantime the virus is replicating and killing immune cells (which it targets). Since the virus changes it's ID tag so much and so often, it's hard to keep track of what's what in the body and it usually kills all the immune cells that would normally be fighting the virus.

[Cobalt](http://www.playcobalt.com/) is a 2D arena type shooting game developed by Oxeye Games and published by Mojang. The game has couple of different modes. Story mode, deathmatch/team deathmatch and plug smash.

You and your friends play as robots fighting each other in small arenas. Weapons are varied from really crappy peashooters to missile launchers. Melee weapons aren't that interesting but there is some variety there as well.

Gameplay revolves around maneuvering quickly around the map, deflecting shots by rolling and hoarding weapons. You can punch missiles and grenades mid-air or you can shoot them back at the enemy for a deflect kill. Rolling also gives more speed to your grenade throws so you can get them across the map if you're skilled enough. When projectiles or grenades are close to a person, the game goes into bullet time. This gives extra time to get out of the way or to counter them.

There is also a story mode that can be played locally by 1-2 players. Dissapointingly, this mode is not yet available online. Online isn't very populated yet and the lag ruins the match if you aren't in the same region. I bought this game years ago when it was still in alpha and frankly I'm dissapointed with the current state of online. There is no chat or any way of naming your server for example.
